dedupe_keys.name: eagle i power outage data 2025 county level customer outages at 15 minute intervals ornl

description: This dataset is the 2025 annual release of the EAGLE-I historic power outage record, published by Oak Ridge National Laboratory on OSTI in February 2026. It gives outage information at the county level for 2025 at 15-minute intervals, collected by the EAGLE-I programme from utilities' public outage maps through an ETL process. Each row carries the FIPS code, county name, state name, total number of customers without power and a date and timestamp; detailed metadata sit in a linked metadata record. Coverage is United States counties for one calendar year, and earlier years are separate releases. Access: the OSTI record and dataset DOI 10.13139/ORNLNCCS/3012826, free; the OSTI page states no licence, and the file format was not listed on the page read. Caveats: values reflect what utility maps publish, so utilities without public maps and customer count denominators are not part of the record. It suits outage frequency, duration and resilience studies, and relates to the earlier EAGLE-I release and the 2015 to 2024 outage and weather event linkage catalogued here.
